name: Widowhale Quiver (One Mana Left, 0.5.0)
starting_state: rare, fractured +2 Projectile Skills prefix, 4+ mods
target: Fractured +2 Projectile Skills quiver with T1 flat lightning, projectile speed, and double crit suffixes
notes: Adapted from One Mana Left's 0.3.0 Widowhale Amazon quiver craft for 0.5.0.
Key difference from Deadeye version: +2 proj gems (exponential scaling) instead of attack speed (linear).
Step 1 is the creator's original tech — omen-assisted prefix slam can skip the 1-in-4 entirely.
Step 3 (essence of abyss + dextral crystallisation) removes a suffix deterministically.
Step 4 (essence of hysteria) adds the hysteria suffix mod.
Step 5 (same-type omen + perfect exalt) finishes with double crit.
Total expected cost: ~20 divines for prefixes, suffixes add ~5-10 more.
0.5.0 note: Essence of Hysteria was nerfed (ES Recharge Rate reduced) but still usable.
STARTING POINT: Buy a fractured +2 proj gems visceral quiver (ilvl 82+) from trade. Already rare.

steps.precondition: Rare quiver with fractured +2 proj prefix, open prefix slots available
steps.goal: T1 flat lightning damage to attacks (AddsFlatLightningDamageToAttacks)
steps.until: Prefixes contain T1 flat lightning damage
steps.note: In PoE 2, Chaos Orb removes 1 random non-fractured mod and adds 1 new mod of the same type (prefix→prefix, suffix→suffix). T1 lightning is ~1 in 260 chaos per hit, costing ~5-7 divines average. Chaos are cheap (~50:1 div).

steps.precondition: Rare quiver with fractured +2 proj, T1 lightning prefix, open prefix slot
steps.result: Guaranteed prefix slam — 50/50 chance to hit projectile speed prefix
steps.note: Creator's key tech: omen guarantees prefix slot, so the exalt can only roll proj speed (the only other prefix group). If it hits, skip to step 5.

steps.precondition: Rare quiver with open prefix slot (proj speed NOT hit in step 2)
steps.result: Prefix slam with min ilvl 35 filter — ~1/7-8 for T1-T2 proj speed
steps.note: Creator's original tech: Greater Exalt costs ~12 exalts (cheap). Filters low-ilvl mods, dramatically boosting proj speed odds. If this hits, skip to step 5. This is how the creator succeeded on attempt 3.

steps.precondition: Rare quiver after steps 1-2, proj speed NOT hit, has suffixes to manipulate
steps.result: Removes a suffix deterministically (omen controls slot), adds new mod
steps.note: Essence of Abyss is a corrupted essence (works on magic/rare in 0.5.0). Dextral Crystallisation omen makes it remove only suffixes. Opens a suffix slot for hysteria.

steps.precondition: Rare quiver with open suffix slot
steps.note: Corrupted essence, nerfed in 0.5.0 (ES Recharge Rate: 41-45% → 20-23%) but still usable.

steps.precondition: Rare quiver with open suffix slot(s)
steps.result: Suffix slam with min ilvl 50 filter — targets crit mods
steps.note: Perfect Exalt filters to ilvl 50+ mods. With attack/critical tags, targets crit chance and crit multi. Attack speed is also valid (highest DPS but mana-hungry). ~1/3 to hit a crit mod.
